sec: Chronic hepatitis treatment tree, thresholds, targets, available therapies and doses

items.q: Treatment tree — match the cirrhosis status to the printed step — 1) Cirrhosis -ve, low infectivity 2) Cirrhosis +ve, compensated 3) Cirrhosis +ve, decompensated … A) Treatment B) Treatment / transplant C) Follow up
items.exp: 'Low infectivity → Follow up'; 'Cirrhosis → Treatment'; 'Decompensated Cirrhosis → Treatment / transplant'. (Book p1043)

items.q: Treatment threshold printed for the HBeAg-positive chronic hepatitis branch?
opts: HBV DNA > 20,000 IU/mL and ALT > 2 times the upper limit of normal
HBV DNA > 2,000 IU/mL and ALT > 2 times the upper limit of normal
HBV DNA > 20,000 IU/mL with normal ALT
Any detectable HBV DNA with ALT > 5 times the upper limit
items.exp: 'HBeAg +ve : HBV DNA > 20,000 IU/mL; ALT > 2 times of upper limit'. (Book p1043)

items.q: Treatment threshold printed for the HBeAg-negative branch?
opts: HBV DNA > 2,000 IU/mL and ALT > 2 times the upper limit of normal
HBV DNA > 20,000 IU/mL and ALT > 2 times the upper limit of normal
HBV DNA > 200 IU/mL and ALT > 5 times the upper limit
HBV DNA undetectable with ALT > 2 times the upper limit
items.exp: 'HBeAg -ve : HBV DNA > 2,000 IU/mL; ALT > 2 times of upper limit'. (Book p1043)

items.q: Judge the treatment branches: I The HBV DNA threshold for treatment is ten times higher in the HBeAg-positive than in the HBeAg-negative branch. II The ALT criterion is the same in both.
items.exp: 20,000 vs 2,000 IU/mL, with 'ALT > 2 times of upper limit' in both branches. (Book p1043)

items.q: Targets of treatment — match — 1) HBeAg positive 2) HBeAg negative … A) Seroconversion B) ALT normal and suppression of HBV DNA
items.exp: 'Target of treatment : HBeAg -ve : Seroconversion · ALT normal · Suppress HBV DNA' as printed. (Book p1043)

items.q: Fill up: the two printed aims listed under 'Target of treatment' are ______ and ______.
opts: ALT twice normal; detectable HBV DNA
items.exp: '· ALT normal · Suppress HBV DNA'. (Book p1043)

items.q: Available therapies — match — 1) IFN-α 2) Lamivudine 3) Tenofovir disoproxil 4) Tenofovir alafenamide … A) 300 mg OD, A/e proximal RTA and bone mineral disease B) S/c, about 30% seroconversion, psychosis / autoimmune thyroiditis / marrow suppression C) DOC, latest, 25 mg OD, fewer side effects D) good initial response but YMDD mutation and resistance
items.exp: IFN-α: S/c, '30% Seroconversion', psychosis, autoimmune thyroiditis, bone marrow suppression. Lamivudine: 'Initially good response', 'YMDD mutation → Resistance, Nephrotoxic'. Tenofovir disoproxil: '300 mg OD Daily', 'A/e : RTA Type 2 (Proximal PCT toxicity), Bone mineral disease'. Tenofovir alafenamide: 'DOC', 'Latest', '25 mg OD Daily', 'Less side effect compared to Tenofovir disoproxil'. (Book p1043)

items.q: Fill up (Interferon): given ______, it achieves about ______ seroconversion.
Which is NOT a printed limitation of interferon therapy in chronic hepatitis B?
items.exp: 'Limitation : No role in HBeAg -ve patient · No role in cirrhosis · No role in young asian'; nephrotoxicity is listed under lamivudine. (Book p1043)

items.q: Which is NOT a printed adverse effect of interferon in this list?
items.exp: 'A/e : Psychosis · Autoimmune thyroiditis · Bone marrow suppression'. Proximal RTA is a tenofovir disoproxil adverse effect. (Book p1043)

items.q: What is the resistance mechanism printed against lamivudine?
What verdict does the page give for lamivudine plus adefovir combination?
items.exp: Against 'Lamivudine + Adefovir' the page prints '· No significant benefit'. (Book p1043)

items.q: Dose printed for tenofovir disoproxil fumarate?

items.exp: 'Tenofovir Alafenamide : · DOC · Latest · 25 mg OD Daily'. (Book p1043)

items.q: Adverse effects — match — 1) Tenofovir disoproxil 2) Tenofovir alafenamide … A) Fewer side effects than tenofovir disoproxil B) RTA type 2 (proximal PCT toxicity) and bone mineral disease
items.exp: Disoproxil: 'A/e : RTA Type 2 (Proximal PCT toxicity) · Bone mineral disease'. Alafenamide: 'Less side effect compared to Tenofovir disoproxil'. (Book p1043)

items.q: Which drug does the page call the drug of choice and the latest agent?
A cirrhotic patient with chronic hepatitis B needs treatment. Which drug is specifically recorded as having no role in cirrhosis?
items.exp: 'Limitation : … · No role in cirrhosis' is printed under IFN-α. (Book p1043)
